name: Bathroom Heating
steps: Tap the plant pot to reveal hidden chili sauce.
Feed the chili sauce to the man.
Close the window to stop cold air.
Tap the phone to order a massage service.
Give the hot soup to the man in the tub.
Open the bathtub panel and increase the temperature.
Cover the tub with the bathrobe to trap steam.
Tap the faucet to add more hot water.
